security.title: Your information. Your decisions.
security.desc: You choose who can see each item, and you can change or remove access whenever you like. You can download a full copy of your vault at any time. Your vault is stored in London and protected with encryption at rest and in transit, and we never sell your data. The details, including the services we rely on outside the UK, are on our Security page.

faq.title: Good to know before you start.

items.q: What can I do for free?
items.a: Quite a lot. The free plan gives you the guided setup, your About Me profile, 5 accounts or assets, 5 documents, 3 trusted people and a readiness score. It has no time limit and needs no card. Everstead+ removes the limits and adds a second vault for your partner, personal messages and 25 GB of storage.

Only you, until you decide otherwise. You can give a partner, a family member or an adviser access to specific items, person by person, and change or remove that access whenever you like. No one at Everstead looks at your vault in the normal running of the service; our Security page explains exactly how access works.

items.q: What happens when my family needs access?
items.a: Whatever you have already shared with someone stays available to them. For everything you set aside for later, a trusted person you named reports a death or incapacity with the supporting details, a person at Everstead verifies it, usually within two business days, and only then does the access you chose open. Nothing opens on its own.
Yes, at any time and on any plan. From Settings you can download a complete copy of your vault: accounts, documents and their files, instructions, wishes and people, in a single ZIP.

No. A will is a legal document, and Everstead does not write one or give legal advice. Everstead is where you keep the practical information around it: where the original is, who to call, what you own and what you would like to happen. Many people use it alongside a solicitor.
